name: input_tweakparam_vision
about: TweakParam 'VISION 0' blinds an NPC. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::InputTweakParam 0x1029ea40 -> slot 585 ProcessTweakParam writes the named perception tunable; with VISION 0 the sense pass admits nothing (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/senses.md), so no SEE_* condition is set afterwards. The param is verbatim from ch_temple_1 (guard_east_quarters_Sleeping1 'VISION 0'). sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg) verbatim; the player 300 units in front of it at arena (975, 762) cm (the stage turns the row's Source yaw 270 into Unreal yaw 90, ElysiumArenaStage.cpp AuthoredYaw; corrected 2026-10-04 by V2: at 'start' the player stood 90 degrees off Hunter1's own yaw 270, outside its 0.2 cone, so the record passed with Hunter1 blind for the wrong reason -- now it must see him before the tweak); SetRelationship 'player D_HT 5' after the tweak makes the player hated, and still he is not seen.
notes: SEE_PLAYER before the tweak (t < 1 s) is retail too, so the never is on what a sight produces with a hated player: OnFoundPlayer and the move to COMBAT.
